evidence: https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits - "Free usage limits apply to free model variants ending in :free."
https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits - "Less than 10 credits purchased allows 20 requests per minute and 50 per day."
https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits - "At least 10 credits purchased allows 20 requests per minute and 1000 per day."
https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits - "The tier depends on all-time credits purchased, starting one credit below the threshold."
https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq - "1. :free - A free version of the model with its own rate limits."
https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq - "If you have purchased at least 10 credits, your free model rate limit will be 1000 requests per day."
https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq - "Otherwise, you will be rate limited to 50 free model API requests per day."

notes: CONDITION on the recorded numbers: rpm=20 and rpd=50 hold only for an account whose ALL-TIME purchased credits are below the 10-credit threshold (the higher ceiling is granted starting one credit below it, per the docs). Once >=10 credits are purchased, rpm stays 20 but the daily cap becomes 1000/day; the tier is chosen by all-time credits purchased, independently of current balance, so it never falls back. Pages actually read for OpenRouter: /docs/api-reference/limits (title 'Limits'; it also states OpenRouter enforces Credit limits, Budget limits and Rate limits) and /docs/faq (:free variant definition + both daily caps). NO official figure was found for TPM, TPD, a monthly token pool, or a context window - the docs give no token-per-minute number for :free models and the context length of the openrouter/free router is only published on the JS-rendered model page (https://openrouter.ai/openrouter/free), which returned no readable numbers; the 200K/1M figures circulating in third-party posts were NOT used. The catalogue carries only the router slug openrouter/free, but the :free rate limits apply to every model variant whose ID ends in :free, so the numbers above are pool-wide, not per-slug. Per the FAQ the free endpoints additionally require the privacy settings that allow free endpoints which train on request data / publish prompts. ToS note: https://openrouter.ai/terms section 7.4 forbids accessing the Service "for purposes of reselling API access to Models or otherwise developing a competing service" - relevant because this app ships OpenRouter as a routed aggregate entry.
